name: 95448 · Healdsburg, CA
findings: ZIP 95448 (Healdsburg) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95448 (Healdsburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95448 (Healdsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
